Run the highdir Shiny app

Source: R/run_app.R
run_app.Rd

Launches the interactive app for creating charts with highdir functions. Use parameters to change defaults or pass feature flags.

Usage

run_app(
  ...,
  .return_app = FALSE,
  host = getOption("shiny.host", "127.0.0.1"),
  port = getOption("shiny.port"),
  launch.browser = getOption("shiny.launch.browser", interactive())
)

Arguments

...

Named options passed to the app (optional).

.return_app

logical. If TRUE, return the shiny.appobj instead of launching it. Default is FALSE.

host

Host to listen on (default "127.0.0.1").

port

Port to listen on (default: random).

launch.browser

Open browser automatically? (default: interactive())

Value

A shiny.appobj; called for its side effects.

Examples

if (FALSE)  highdir::run_app()  # \dontrun{}
